sentences.text: Fossils have been recovered in Belgium, France, and Luxembourg.
Three fossil occurrences of the species are known.
Palaeobrachaelurus vanessae is recognized as a valid species.
It is placed in the family Brachaeluridae, although the Paleobiology Database lists it under Hemiscylliidae.
The animal belongs to the class Chondrichthyes, the cartilaginous fishes.
The species lived in the Jurassic, specifically from the Toarcian to the Bajocian ages.
Fossils date between 182.9 and 168.6 million years ago.
